description: Lists Siro's pay-per-call resources (67 in total) with id, name, category, USD price and a one-line summary. Use it first to find the right resource id; then read its input schema with siro_resource_schema and run it with siro_call. Categories: LLMs, image generation, audio (speech and transcription), vision, web (reading and translation), on-chain data on Robinhood Chain and Base, tokenized stocks, Polymarket prediction markets and content tools. Free, no payment needed.

query.description: Optional words to match against the id, name, summary and tags, e.g. "stock", "image", "polymarket". Omit to list everything.

name: siro_resources
title: Search the Siro catalog
